notes.title: Cold Eye School Trailer & Demo Update LIVE!
notes.content:
Dearest Hero,

Prepare your mind (and body) for pain as you learn to master the art of Endurance and Retaliation in the updated demo!

[previewyoutube=WQA02j5aJEc;full][/previewyoutube]
Revealing the Cold Eye School, a brutal new martial path in a fresh gameplay trailer for Forestrike. The latest update adds this hard-hitting discipline to your arsenal, alongside the evasive Leaf Style. 

[b]Cold Eye School ❄️[/b]
Founded by the ruthless Master Nodai, the Cold Eye school is the second of five martial paths in Forestrike. Built around the chilling principles of Endurance and Retaliation, Cold Eye fighters block or even sacrifice health to absorb incoming damage and fuel devastating counterattacks.

Driven by a thirst for revenge after being discarded by the Imperial court, Master Nodai’s merciless techniques reflect a philosophy forged in pain and war. [b]Only by embracing pain can one deliver true justice. [/b]

[b]Leaf Style is here to stay 🍃[/b]
Of course, Master Talgun’s Leaf Style remains available for those who prefer elegance and evasion over brute retaliation. However, now you can try both schools and harness the power to unlock hybrid abilities and experiment with deadly combinations of speed, precision and overwhelming power. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/4b455e47474049b4e8e9ede3e461cbaa754e5690.jpg[/img]
[b]Share Fights 👊[/b]
Did you know you can share your fights and have other players try them? Or you can load up fights shared by others to give them a helping hand in mastering the battle!

[b]How to get your fight code[/b]
[list][*]After you finish a fight there will be a ‘Copy Fight Code’ in the top right hand corner during the replay.
[/*][*]Copy this code and share with others![/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/7371e8c02cb71308e9412040004e3a6cb1220541.gif[/img]

[b]How to load up a copied fight code?[/b]
[list][*]Copy the fight code received
[/*][*]Go to the far right of the Moon Gate and interact with the furthest gate
[/*][*]There should be a prompt when you approach the gate saying ‘Load Fight from Code’
[/*][*]Interact with the gate and this should automatically load the copied fight code![/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/1d7a268f3f049005107ff9967a697e4c350f83ad.gif[/img]

[b]What is Forestrike?[/b]
[i]Forestrike is a tactical kung fu roguelike where failure is the teacher and every battle is a lesson in precision. Use the game’s unique Foresight system to simulate combat before engaging in the real battle, then execute your plan with perfect timing. Or start again, stronger and wiser.[/i]

We’re also excited to announce that Forestrike will be [b]officially launching this year on PC and Nintendo Switch in 2025![/b]

Make sure to join our Discord server to strategize with the community, offer feedback and prepare for the intense battle ahead! 

[h3]🎮 Play the Updated Demo Now & Wishlist on Steam![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325930/Forestrike_Demo/

notes.title: Patch v.1-120
notes.content:
[h3]Honorable heroes,[/h3]

Thank you all for playing the demo and for your feedback on the game so far!

We just released a small patch that adds community suggested improvements and better quality of life.

[h3]PATCH NOTES v.1-120[/h3]

[b]Input[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Key Rebinding for both Keyboard and Controllers
[*] Added support for multiple Controllers connected at once and input hot swapping
[*] Added support for many more niche controllers[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/caeaeb3e20669e6f8e6d63d10113bc4041b5565c.png[/img]
[b]Other Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Support for many more resolutions
[*] Fixed an issue with some resolutions cropping off the sides of the fight screen
[*] Fixed an issue with some UI elements not scaling correctly on ultra wide resolutions
[*] Added options for VSync
[*] Fixed an issue with some sounds not being affected by Sound Level settings
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where technique tips wouldn't show up on some technique menus
[*] Adjusted techniques UI to fit the screen better across most menus
[*] Fixed an issue with some techniques causing potential soft locks
[/list]
We will continue to work on fixing any more pesky bugs that do crop up so please carry on voicing your suggestions and feedback to us in the Steam forums and [url=https://discord.gg/Forestrike]Discord[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/fe552da1cd450d29a9f1c36912380e4d44b15b04.gif[/img]

notes.title: Our first Forestrike demo is live NOW on Steam! 🍃
notes.content:
[h3]Dearest Hero,[/h3]

Your patience has been rewarded and the [b]Forestrike Demo[/b] is officially live! The time has come for you to embark on your journey and master the skill of [b]Foresight.[/b] 

Step into the shoes of Yu, a skilled martial artist who is on a mission to liberate the Emperor. You will have to master the unique ability of Foresight that allows you to preview your fights and strategize in advance the perfect combat sequence before striking.

[previewyoutube=DQvhBv8kTlc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Leaf School 🍃[/h3]
Meet Master Talgun who sees combat not as a means to destroy, but as a path to understanding. He is the first of five masters you will encounter on your journey and will guide you through the Leaf Style, a martial art rooted in evasion and redirection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/dbce648f6858f0b631489912189e07ef5d27711a.png[/img]
Violence is your last resort, instead turn your enemies' force against them, deflecting blows, seizing their weapons, and exploiting every mistake they make. Evasive, graceful, flowing: such is the way of the Leaf school.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111376/010c26b68af5ae287be90908b1dca08a5ee6933a.png[/img]
This is just your first step into a world of tactical kung-fu mastery. The battle for the Emperor’s freedom begins now, will you rise to the challenge? 💥

Download the [b]Forestrike demo now[/b] and make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Forestrike][b]Discord server[/b][/url] to strategize with the community, offer feedback and prepare for the intense battle ahead!

Click on the 'Download demo' button on the Steam page to download the game.
